title: lactuca dentata subvar. alpicola
intro: Lactuca dentata subvar. alpicola, commonly known as the Alpine Prickly Lettuce, is a plant species belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is traditionally used for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as digestive issues and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Prickly Lettuce include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as an antiseptic. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include sesquiterpene lactones and other flavonoids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities.
